mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO wf_riven (id, url_name, en, zh, r_group, req_mastery_rank, riven_type, disposition) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.urlName}, #{item.enName}, #{item.zhName}, #{item.rGroup}, #{item.reqMasteryRank}, #{item.rivenType}, #{item.disposition})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = VALUES(id), en = VALUES(en), zh = VALUES(zh), url_name = VALUES(url_name), r_group = VALUES(r_group), req_mastery_rank = VALUES(req_mastery_rank), riven_type = VALUES(riven_type), disposition = VALUES(disposition)
mapper.select: SELECT id, url_name AS urlName, en AS enName, zh AS zhName, r_group AS rGroup FROM wf_riven WHERE r_group NOT IN ('lich', 'sister') ORDER BY url_name
